n: To share your work with an AI tool is to decide what it gets to see. Give it the page you are working from and the reason you are writing, and the help gets better. Leave out what is private or what belongs to someone else. Before you paste, ask one plain question: would I hand this to a new coworker on their first day? If yes, share it. If no, keep it.
